method.turn_numbers: One-based: first1 is the first simultaneous action/scoring turn.
method.attempted: Each explicit PLACE_TRACKS occurrence in recorded stdout, including neutral collisions; repeated coordinates would count repeatedly.
method.accepted_owned: Recorded type-1 placements with owner equal to player 0/1; owner-2 neutral placements excluded. This is an event count, not surviving end-of-window track stock.
method.protected: The initial map region contains a town. Core GameState.regionHasTown and Rules.expand prohibit disruption there.
method.town_adjacent: Manhattan distance exactly one to a recorded town; distinct towns are the union across this side's opening cells.
method.empty_disruption: Recorded type-2 event targets a region with no tracks in the observed event occupancy after prior placements and ink events, including this turn's prior placement events. Neutral tracks count as tracks.
method.points: Sums of recorded type-3 point events, not a local scoring implementation or counterfactual.
method.selection: Fixed 23 newly fetched leader games plus 5 own arena games from build/cg-fetch-v07-study.log; exactly 20 highest-ID canonical boss games available at selection. Fixed IDs are embedded in the reproducer.
method.version_attribution: Boss cohort attributed to v07 by the user. Own latest arena agent 6747874 is identified by metadata; its uploaded source hash is not verified here.

limitations: Descriptive observational samples; no strength test or causal attribution.
Top cohort contains both sides of 23 games, with repeated players and pairings (RamzaBeoulve 17 sides); 46 sides are not 46 independent games.
Own, boss and top cohorts have different maps, opponents and game durations; early income cannot rank their strengths.
Attempted cells may collide and become neutral. Accepted-owned event counts separately expose that difference.
Protected track ownership does not guarantee the region remains connected or that its tracks earn points.
Empty-region sabotage does not prove territorial-denial intent; no counterfactual benefit was measured.
This parser does not run engine fidelity validation; use the parent study's cgValidate/cgRender results separately.
